proposal.architecture: Add a SOOP-owned watch-only VOD host/registry and typed API, following the lifecycle algorithms of YouTube original_vod but not importing its policy, identifiers, state or DOM adapter. The only shared provider-specific persistent resource is the existing soop-original-profile directory. Keep separate VOD tokens, titleNo, epoch, viewer aliases, request binding, status and viewport sequence. Do not fake a channel/broadcast snapshot.
proposal.presentation: Add an actual central play action to the existing SOOP video detail. Keep favorite, download and channel actions and the existing card-selection rules. Once playing, render the original embedded VOD video plus its available official replay chat inside the established floating detail using native geometry slots; do not rebuild provider controls or insert a custom HTML video player. Keep the mounted session when the containing provider/tab is hidden, and close only on explicit viewer/detail close or normal lifecycle cleanup. Different-video replacement and late close must not close the current viewer.
proposal.document: Open exactly https://vod.sooplive.com/player/<validated decimal titleNo>/embed?showChat=true in one native child using the retained SOOP profile. Treat this as watch-only: no MediaRef, OfficialReceiverLease, recording owner, encoded/chat capture bridge, scheduler, downloader or recording button. Existing explicit VOD download remains a separate validated action and is not silently started by watch.
proposal.viewport: Use platform_native_geometry for full-client coordinates, clipping and occlusion, and a source-owned VOD adapter for #player and #chatting_area/#chatbox_height. Do not reuse the livePlayer layout/capture script. Preserve provider aspect ratio, original identity/quality/seek/replay/fullscreen controls and original chat synchronization. When official metadata disables chat, remove the reserved chat slot rather than show an indefinite blank/loading panel. On small layouts use the established adjustable side-by-side/stacked player-chat geometry without hidden scrollbars or clipped control edges.
proposal.account: Reuse the existing SOOP profile and existing login popup flow only. VOD status may report local restricted/error state, but must not become another writer of global account authority or alter login completion, security pages, logout revisions, campaign behavior or scheduled/live capture readiness. After an accepted existing account revision, a narrow watch-only refresh hook may reload only VOD views; never reload a recording receiver. Authentication input remains user-operated.
proposal.limits: Retain the established maximum4 provider native playback documents across live and VOD through a small presentation-only admission check/guard, not the recording approval gate. Reopening the same VOD reuses its document with a distinct viewer lease; at capacity, reject a new different document visibly without evicting live/scheduled work. The count/check must be atomic with simultaneous live/VOD opens and must not hold locks while waiting for network/UI completion. If this cannot be added without changing live scheduling behavior, split admission work into an explicitly reviewed prerequisite instead of silently increasing limits.
proposal.lifecycle: Delegate normal shutdown, frontend detach, tray mute and accepted account refresh to the watch-only registry from existing SOOP lifecycle points. Keep minimization separate from tray mute; privacy hides and mutes while preserving session; unrelated tab hiding preserves playback/sound. Maintain fullscreen ownership tied to the exact VOD token, not channel names or another platform's event. EOF updates state but does not destroy the document, so native replay and seek still work.
